# Brandon Cornett Fiction

> > Brandon Cornett's author site featuring science fiction and horror novels, including The Holdbacks and the Machine Wars series, plus comprehensive writing guides for speculative fiction.

Brandon Cornett is a sci-fi and horror author based in Boston, known for AI-themed thrillers and post-apocalyptic fiction. The site offers both his published works and extensive craft tutorials for aspiring writers in the horror, science fiction, and dark fantasy genres.

## Key Topics

- Brandon Cornett
- The Holdbacks
- Machine Wars series

## Books & Series

- [Novels Written by Brandon Cornett](https://cornettfiction.com/books): Author's catalog: The Mall, Purgatory, The Holdbacks & other novels
- [Machine Wars: A Sci-Fi Book Series](https://cornettfiction.com/machine-wars): Machine Wars series page: humans vs AI thriller starting with The Mall

## Horror Writing Guides

- [How to Write a Horror Story: A Complete Guide for Beginners](https://cornettfiction.com/how-to-write-horror-fiction): Complete beginner's guide to writing horror short stories from start to finish
- [Building the Bones: 10 Ways to Structure a Horror Short Story](https://cornettfiction.com/how-to-structure-a-horror-story): Guide to 10 common story structures for horror fiction plotting
- [How to Develop a Scary Atmosphere for a Horror Story](https://cornettfiction.com/developing-a-scary-atmosphere-for-a-story): Tutorial on creating atmosphere in horror using The Shining as example
- [How to Describe the Setting in a Horror Story](https://cornettfiction.com/effective-horror-story-settings): Tutorial on horror settings from Overlook Hotel to Blair Witch's forest
- [How to Start a Horror or Suspense Novel: Options for Writers](https://cornettfiction.com/starting-a-horror-or-suspense-novel): Guide to opening chapters and beginnings for horror/suspense novels

## Science Fiction Writing Guides

- [What Is Science Fiction? A Genre Definition for Reader and Writers](https://cornettfiction.com/what-is-science-fiction): Genre definition guide explaining sci-fi vs fantasy with Jurassic Park refs
- [Writing a Science Fiction Story About Artificial Intelligence (AI)](https://cornettfiction.com/writing-ai-science-fiction-stories): Guide to writing AI-themed sci-fi stories (not using ChatGPT to write)
- [7 Mistakes to Avoid When Writing Science Fiction Stories](https://cornettfiction.com/sci-fi-writing-mistakes-to-avoid): Guide to common pitfalls in sci-fi writing and how to avoid them

## Post-Apocalyptic & Zombie Fiction

- [How to Write a Post-Apocalyptic Novel: 7 Tips for Beginner Writers](https://cornettfiction.com/write-a-post-apocalyptic-novel): Beginner's guide to writing post-apocalyptic novels with plotting tips
- [Post-Apocalyptic World Building in Fiction: 7 Solid Tips for Writers](https://cornettfiction.com/post-apocalyptic-world-building-for-writers): Worldbuilding tips for post-apocalyptic fiction citing The Road & Station Eleven
- [Why Is Post-Apocalyptic Fiction So Popular With Readers and Writers?](https://cornettfiction.com/why-is-post-apocalyptic-popular): Analysis of post-apocalyptic genre appeal from The Road to Mad Max
- [How to Create a Realistic, Immersive World in Zombie Fiction](https://cornettfiction.com/realistic-immersive-zombie-fiction): Guide to writing believable zombie stories with research-based worldbuilding
- [Ten Different Ways to Start a Zombie Apocalypse Story or Novel](https://cornettfiction.com/how-to-start-a-zombie-story): 10 story starters for zombie apocalypse fiction with pacing advice

## Articles & Blog

- [Articles and Essays by Brandon Cornett](https://cornettfiction.com/articles): Collection of writing guides on sci-fi, horror & fiction craft techniques
- [Latest Blog Posts](https://cornettfiction.com/blog): Blog index featuring horror writing, flash fiction & atmosphere techniques
- [15 Fantasy Book Series That Offer Complex World-Building](https://cornettfiction.com/fantasy-series-complex-world-building): Curated list of 15 fantasy series featuring N.K. Jemisin, C.S. Lewis & more
- [The Dark Fantasy Fiction Genre Explained](https://cornettfiction.com/dark-fantasy-genre-explained): Genre guide covering dark fantasy from Glen Cook to Stephen King's work
